verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's own materials mention 'hibernating WebSockets' billed only for compute, and Durable Object–backed agents with 'built-in support for real-time communication', 'one per user, per session, per game room'. That points to first-party persistent-connection support, but the evidence is thin and indirect. A 2022 community comment says WebSockets were then in beta; this reflects maturity at that time rather than a concrete failure. missing for 10: dedicated WebSocket API documentation for Workers/Durable Objects, documented connection limits and lifecycle details, independent hands-on corroboration of production real-time use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can handle persistent WebSocket connections from within edge/serverless functions for real-time apps

citations.quote: Cloudflare charges only for compute, not wall time, even during long agent workflows or hibernating WebSockets.
Each agent has its own state, storage, and lifecycle — with built-in support for real-time communication, scheduling, AI model calls, MCP, workflows, and more.
